mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name IN ('tb_ws_group', 'tb_ws_group_member')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'tb_board' AND column_name = 'ws_group_id')
SELECT id, group_name, description, sort_order, created_by, created_at FROM tb_ws_group ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ws_group (group_name, description, sort_order, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT m.group_id, m.user_id, m.member_role, u.username, u.display_name AS name, u.department, u.is_active FROM tb_ws_group_member m JOIN tb_app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY CASE m.member_role WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.display_name
SELECT group_id, member_role FROM tb_ws_group_member WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT member_role FROM tb_ws_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ws_group_member (group_id, user_id, member_role) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ws_group_member SET member_role = #{role} WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_ws_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_ws_group_member GROUP BY group_id
SELECT ws_group_id FROM tb_board WHERE id = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_board SET ws_group_id = #{groupId} WHERE id = #{boardId}
UPDATE tb_board SET ws_group_id = #{groupId} WHERE ws_group_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board WHERE ws_group_id = #{groupId}
